propositions: Parent-drift breadcrumb is skipped in live-search path when child has zero local comments because _diff_comments returns early at the 'if not local_comments' guard before _build_parent_breadcrumb is reached
In snapshot path the breadcrumb is emitted correctly even with zero local comments because the snapshot carries the comment field and the breadcrumb append occurs after guard
Live-search path must fetch comments even with zero local comments when drift condition applies and a bound ancestor exists, to populate the dedup set for breadcrumb append-once logic
Extraction of Jira-comment-set resolution and breadcrumb-target logic into separate helpers keeps _diff_comments under McCabe complexity ceiling of 15
Client-None and fetch-failure safety (bug-4292) is preserved by returning empty list before breadcrumb when transport is unavailable or fetch fails
